description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Storm-Kiln Artist, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.
